# anygen

One CLI, one credit balance, every generative AI model.

`anygen` is a terminal client for the anygen gateway: image (nano-banana,
seedream), video (seedance), music and speech (minimax), with more models added
server-side — the CLI never changes. Users pay once in credits and use every
model through a single `ag-sk-…` API key; third-party provider protocols are
absorbed by the gateway adapters, invisible to users.

中文简介:**一个 CLI + 一处充值积分 + 全模型聚合(图/视频/音乐/语音)。三方厂商协议全部由网关吸收,用户只面对一个 key、一套命令。**

## Architecture

```
anygen CLI ─┐
skills      ├─► anygen gateway (unified async job protocol)
MCP later ──┘         │
                      ├─ provider adapter: Volcengine Ark (Seedance/Seedream)
                      ├─ provider adapter: Google Gemini API (nano banana)
                      ├─ provider adapter: MiniMax (music/TTS)
                      │   … one module per upstream
                      └─ credit ledger · pricing table · API keys
```

Every modality speaks the same lifecycle:

```http
POST /v1/videos/generations        # also /images /music /speech
x-api-key: ag-sk-…

{ "model": "seedance-2.5", "prompt": "…",
  "params": { "duration_seconds": 8 } }

→ 202 { "job_id": "job_01J…", "credits_charged": 64, "balance": 936 }

GET /v1/jobs/job_01J…              # queued → running → succeeded | failed
GET /v1/models                     # catalog + per-unit pricing (gateway-driven)
GET /v1/account/balance
```

Billing semantics (the parts users care about):

- **charged on submit**, refunded automatically when a job fails
- `402 insufficient_credits` carries `{required, balance}`
- failed submissions are idempotent-safe via `Idempotency-Key` (planned)

## Install

```bash
cargo install --path .          # builds `anygen` and `anygen-mockd`
```

## Quick start (against the local mock gateway)

No backend needed for development/demo:

```bash
anygen-mockd --port 8927 &                 # terminal 1: mock gateway

export ANYGEN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8927
export ANYGEN_API_KEY=ag-sk-test           # any ag-sk-… prefix works

anygen models                              # catalog with credit pricing
anygen balance                             # 5000 credits
anygen video "A cat surfing" --model seedance-2.5 -E duration_seconds=6
#   ✓ Job created: job_000000000000
#     credits charged 48, balance 4952
#   ✓ Downloaded: ./anygen_job_….mp4
anygen speech "__fail__ oops" --model minimax-tts   # failure ⇒ auto refund
anygen list                                # local job history (SQLite)
```

When pointing at production, unset the env vars and log in once:

```bash
anygen login            # stores ag-sk-… at ~/.config/anygen/config.toml
```

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `anygen image/video/music/speech "<prompt>"` | Generate (`--model`, `--duration`, `--ratio`, `--size`, `-E k=v` passthrough) |
| `anygen models [--modality video] [--json]` | Catalog: status, credits/unit, latency |
| `anygen status <job> [--wait]` | Poll job state |
| `anygen download <job>` | Fetch outputs even after URL expiry check |
| `anygen list` / `anygen balance` | Local history / remaining credits |
| `anygen login` / `logout` / `config …` | Account & config |

Exit codes follow CI-friendly conventions: `0` ok, `1` error/failed job, `2`
poll timeout (job still running server-side).

## Roadmap

- [ ] Real gateway: Ark adapter first (team already ships seedance-cli in prod), then Gemini/MiniMax
- [ ] Credit ledger on Postgres + top-ups (Stripe/支付宝);充值码 flow for closed beta
- [ ] Webhook callbacks (`--webhook https://…`)
- [ ] `npx skills add` distribution of SKILL.md packs + MCP server
- [ ] npm distribution binaries (postinstall fetch pattern proven in seedance-cli)

## Status

v0.1.0-skeleton. CLI + protocol + mock gateway are working end-to-end; the
production gateway does not exist yet.

# anygen-cli

Command-line client for the **anygen gateway**: one credit balance, one
`ag-sk-…` API key, every generative model (image / video / music / speech).
Written in Rust. Config at `~/.config/anygen/config.toml`, job history in
SQLite at `~/.config/anygen/jobs.db`.

> Until the production gateway ships, point `ANYGEN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8927`
> at `anygen-mockd` for a fully working offline experience.

---

## Mental model

Every modality is an **async job**: submit → charged immediately → poll →
succeeded | failed. Failed jobs are refunded automatically. Provider-specific
protocols are absorbed by the gateway; users never touch third-party APIs.

```
anygen video "…" --wait
  submit  →  202 {job_id, credits_charged, balance}   # charge happens here
  poll    →  queued → running → succeeded
  fetch   →  outputs downloaded locally
```

## Quick start

```bash
# mock gateway for local dev/demo
anygen-mockd --port 8927 &
export ANYGEN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8927 ANYGEN_API_KEY=ag-sk-test

anygen models                                   # pricing + status catalog
anygen balance                                  # credits left

anygen image "neon koi pond at night" --model nano-banana
anygen image "product shot" -n 4                # multiple outputs
anygen video "drone over reef" --model seedance-2.5 --duration 8 --ratio 16:9
anygen speech "welcome back" --model minimax-tts -E voice=male-qn-qingse
anygen music "lo-fi study loop"                 # preview models reject submits
```

Default wait behavior: generation commands **wait and auto-download** by
default; pass `--no-wait` to fire-and-forget, resume later:

```bash
anygen status <job_id> --wait
anygen download <job_id>
anygen list                                     # local SQLite history
```

## Flag reference (generation)

| Flag | Applies to | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--model/-m` | all | Model id from `anygen models`; falls back to config `model_<modality>` |
| `--reference/-r` | image/video | Input URL or path for i2i/i2v |
| `--duration` | video | Seconds (`params.duration_seconds`) |
| `--ratio` / `--resolution` | video | e.g. `16:9` / `1080p` |
| `--size` | image | `2k/3k/4k` or `WxH` |
| `-n/--count` | image/music | Number of outputs (≤4) |
| `--voice` | speech | Voice id |
| `-E key=value` | all | Arbitrary passthrough param, repeatable |
| `--output/-o` | all | Base output path; extension derived from output type |
| `--timeout` | all | Wait cap in seconds; `exit 2` + job keeps running |
| `--json` / `--quiet` | all | Machine-readable / script mode |

## Billing rules agents must know

1. Credits are **deducted at submit**; the 202 response echoes
   `credits_charged` and new `balance`. Never assume a job start implies free.
2. **Failures refund automatically** — do not double-refund or retry failed
   jobs without changing inputs.
3. HTTP `402 insufficient_credits` includes `{required, balance}`; surface a
   top-up hint instead of retrying.
4. Pricing comes only from `GET /v1/models` (`unit`, `credits_per_unit`);
   never hardcode prices. Cost formulas:
   `video = seconds × price`, `image/song = n × price`.
5. Models with `status: preview` reject submissions — filter them out of
   user-facing suggestions.

## Error handling

| Symptom | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| exit 0 after `--no-wait` but no file | expected: job still running | track via `status --wait` |
| exit 2 "Timed out" | poll window exceeded, server still running | resume `status <id> --wait`, then `download <id>` |
| `model_preview` 400 | submission to preview model | pick an `available` model |
| `insufficient_credits` 402 | balance too low | stop; report required vs balance |
| `relative URL` or expired asset links | output URLs expire | regenerate not needed if already downloaded; else check `jobs.db` |

## Workflow patterns

Batch pipeline with JSON output:

```bash
for p in "${prompts[@]}"; do
  anygen image "$p" --json --no-wait >> jobs.ndjson
done
jq -r .job_id jobs.ndjson | xargs -I{} sh -c 'anygen status {} --wait'
```

## CI note

Env-var auth only (`ANYGEN_API_KEY`); never write keys into files inside CI.
Use `--quiet` and rely on exit codes.

use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum GatewayError {
    #[error("HTTP request failed: {0}")]
    Http(#[from] reqwest::Error),

    #[error("API error ({status}): {message}")]
    Api { status: u16, message: String },

    #[error(
        "insufficient credits: need {required}, balance {balance}. Top up at https://console.anygen.dev/billing"
    )]
    InsufficientCredits { required: f64, balance: f64 },

    #[error("invalid or expired API key (401). Run `anygen login`")]
    InvalidApiKey,

    #[error("rate limited (429), retry after backoff")]
    RateLimited,

    #[error("{0}")]
    Other(String),
}
